title: Last Light on the Lake
invitation: Mara Venn left her lantern under the boardwalk. She said to come before the casino's last bell.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The casino signs go dark for the last payout. Their reflections stay lit just long enough to show a pen under the boards.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: The League puts that stamp on recovery slips. Look under the boards. Did you see it kick?

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: We’ve got until the bell. I can hold the light for the lock or the slip. Which one?

choices.label: Take the weigh-slip
choices.reply: Three live loads on line L-06 went on to Bay Nine. You keep a copy. Mara takes the slip to the night warden.

choices.label: Open the floating pen
choices.reply: A Krabby hauls itself onto Mara's empty tackle box. As she takes it toward the ranger station, the guard pulls down the weigh-slip.

echoes.text: Mara reads the ranger's signed call log. 'Ivo asked him to stop the truck. If someone had listened, we'd be looking for him somewhere else.'
Mara holds the dispatch waybill up to the gate marker. 'L-06 is this gate. They stamped a full load empty.'

secret.title: The Second Weighing
secret.hint: Use the Route 6 record to read the small column on the weigh-slip above the floating pen.
secret.text: The pen was weighed before the truck came and again after it left. The second figure is heavier. Someone was left off the waybill, on purpose.

title: The Light in Bay Nine
invitation: A dispatcher in a borrowed coat is waving from the only booth still lit in the freight yard.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Bay Nine's lights dim in a line. One stays on above a shutter. Someone has scratched IVO into the paint from the inside.

panels.speaker: Freight intercom
panels.text: Night sweep in progress. First gate secured.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Nera pulls a tape sleeve out from under the mug. There’s a second time written through the first in heavier ink.

panels.speaker: Nera Vale
panels.text: Ivo brought me that tape. I promised the shelter crew I’d unlock their door. Did you hear the gate just go?

choices.label: Save the Bay Nine recording
choices.reply: Ivo's voice crackles through the speaker. 'I'm going to the old relay on the pass. I won't give them my name over a freight radio.'

choices.label: Warn the shelter crew
choices.reply: The last volunteer ducks through with a bundle of dry blankets. 'Ivo took the path to the old relay. We left him a lamp.'

echoes.text: Nera sees the Lakeside weight and takes a sleeve from her drawer. 'They overwrote figures here too. Sit where I can see the door.'
A phone message from Mara says a ranger got the Krabby eating again. Nera slides the booth bolt behind you. 'We left a way out here, too.'

secret.title: An Hour Early
secret.hint: Compare both times on the Bay Nine spool sleeve with the Lakeside weigh-slip.
secret.text: The so-called release call was recorded an hour before the truck reached Bay Nine. In the space between announcements, you hear Ivo ask for three bowls of water.

title: One Call Before Dark
invitation: The lookout saw a man strike a match inside the shut relay hut. The light was gone before she could wave back.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The relay light sputters. Four notes break through the static. Ivo steadies the lamp. The freight tag has left a raw circle on his wrist.

panels.speaker: Ivo
panels.text: Look behind the dial. There’s a stair marked under the cathedral. If you see headlights, take it. I’ll wait below.

panels.speaker: Ivo
panels.text: One call left. We can record what happened to me, or get the people on the pass to shelter. Tell me which way to set the switch.

choices.label: Record Ivo's distress call
choices.reply: Ivo reads the time into the handset and signs the relay copy. 'Use my name. Leave the people on the stairs out of it.'

choices.label: Broadcast the trail warning
choices.reply: The trail lamps blink back through the snow. Hikers leave the main road. Ivo pockets the blank relay slip and leads them down the shelter stair.

echoes.text: Ivo hears the Bay Nine recording and puts a hand on the relay switch. 'I'd forgotten how quiet I was speaking. You'll hear me this time.'
Someone has stuffed the relay's cracked window with a blanket. 'The shelter crew brought it up,' Ivo says. 'You got them out.'

secret.title: The Names Behind the Numbers
secret.hint: Find which marks on Ivo's map behind the relay dial match the bay numbers on the voice log.
secret.text: Each bay number leads to a shelter under the pass. Ivo crossed out the numbers and wrote names in their place. At the bottom he wrote: Take the Cathedral stair. Knock twice. Wait.
